page.overview:
What is Archaludon?

Archaludon resembles a tall, bipedal dinosaur. It has a rather blocky appearance. It is mostly a silver color, under it being dark blue, with white triangles appearing higher up on its body, while it has red-ish stripes further down. Its tail ends in two spikes tipped with gold, and it has a silver fin going along the middle of its back. It has light yellow eyes, and at the front of its face there is a dark blue “T” shape. Its arms are silver, with long extensions on the back with gold tips, while in-between its “claws” is dark blue. Its legs are similar to the arms, however they do not have the extension the arms have, unless it is using a certian type of move, where it flattens itself from its normally bent position, where it resembles a bridge.

Archaludon is able to use its terminals to generate and absorb electricity; Archaludon uses its stored electrical energy to fire off a powerful blast. In stormy weather, Archaludon can easily gather more electrical energy and fire it off at a faster rate.

Archaludon evolves from Duraludon when exposed to a Metal Alloy.
